name: Sun Cleric Sun-Touched Armor adds armor from Strength as well as Intellect (#7357)
contract: Sun-Touched Armor 561023 tooltip: 'Increases your Armor by $s2% of your Strength and Intellect...'. Effect 0
is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (182) MiscValueB=0 (Strength), Effect 1 is the same aura type
MiscValueB=3 (Intellect), both EffectBasePoints=249. Player::UpdateArmor() (inherited engine code,
SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_OF_STAT_PERCENT aura whose MiscValue matches Normal armor, with no CoA script
touching effect 0 or 1 (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp only overrides effect index 2, the shield-health term).
The reporter believed Armor only responds to Intellect; Juju Power (16323, a stock single-effect
'+30 Strength' elixir aura, independent of this spell) isolates the Strength term: Armor must rise by
CalculatePct(30, 249) = 74.7 (~70-85 after float accumulation and rounding) purely from a Strength-only
change, with no Intellect change at all.

steps.label: Let login and stat updates settle
Juju Power: a stock, Strength-only +30 buff
SETUP: Strength rose by exactly 30, nothing else
DISCRIMINATING: Armor rises from the Strength-only buff, not only from Intellect
Removing the Strength buff restores the original Armor
